mapper.update: UPDATE movie SET credits_locked = TRUE, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{movieId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movie_manual_extras (movie_key, name, original_name, cover, description, runtime_min, level_id, home_page, start_date, end_date, note) VALUES (#{movieKey}, NULLIF(BTRIM(#{name}), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(#{originalName}), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(#{cover}), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(#{description}), ''), CASE WHEN #{runtimeMin} BETWEEN 30 AND 600 THEN #{runtimeMin}::smallint ELSE NULL END, #{levelId}, NULLIF(BTRIM(#{homePage}), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(#{startDate}), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(#{endDate}), ''), 'admin movie edit') ON CONFLICT (movie_key) DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, movie_manual_extras.name), original_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.original_name, movie_manual_extras.original_name), cover = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cover, movie_manual_extras.cover), description = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.description, movie_manual_extras.description), runtime_min = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.runtime_min, movie_manual_extras.runtime_min), level_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.level_id, movie_manual_extras.level_id), home_page = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.home_page, movie_manual_extras.home_page), start_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.start_date, movie_manual_extras.start_date), end_date = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.end_date, movie_manual_extras.end_date), note = COALESCE(movie_manual_extras.note, EXCLUDED.note), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT movie_tag.id AS id, movie_tag.name AS name, movie_tag.name_zh AS nameZh, movie_tag.name_en AS nameEn FROM movie_tag LEFT JOIN movie_tag_tags ON movie_tag.id = movie_tag_tags.movie_tag_id WHERE movie_tag_tags.movie_id =#{movieId}
SELECT cinema_spec.id, cinema_spec.name, cinema_spec.description FROM cinema_spec LEFT JOIN movie_spec ON movie_spec.spec_id = cinema_spec.id WHERE movie_spec.movie_id =#{movieId}
SELECT hello_movie.id, hello_movie.code, hello_movie.date FROM hello_movie WHERE hello_movie.movie_id =#{movieId}

SELECT COUNT(movie_comment.id) + COUNT(movie_reply.id) AS comment_count FROM movie_comment LEFT JOIN movie_reply ON movie_comment.id = movie_reply.movie_comment_id AND movie_reply.deleted = 0 WHERE movie_comment.movie_id = #{movieId} AND movie_comment.deleted = 0 GROUP BY movie_comment.movie_id

SELECT movie.id, movie.movie_key, movie.cover, movie.cover_url, movie.name, movie.original_name, movie.description, movie.level_id, movie.home_page, movie.start_date, movie.end_date, movie.status, movie.time, movie.watched_count, movie.want_to_see_count, movie.kind, movie.credits_locked FROM movie_show_time LEFT JOIN movie ON movie_show_time.movie_id = movie.id WHERE movie_show_time.deleted = 0 AND movie_show_time.open = TRUE AND movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND movie.deleted = 0 AND movie.kind = 'movie' AND movie.cover IS NOT NULL AND movie.cover != '' GROUP BY movie.id, movie.movie_key, movie.cover, movie.cover_url, movie.name, movie.original_name, movie.description, movie.level_id, movie.home_page, movie.start_date, movie.end_date, movie.status, movie.time, movie.watched_count, movie.want_to_see_count, movie.kind, movie.credits_locked ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT movie_show_time.id) DESC, movie.want_to_see_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT -- movie_show_time.movie_id, COUNT(DISTINCT movie_show_time.cinema_id) AS cinema_count FROM movie_show_time WHERE movie_show_time.deleted = 0 AND movie_show_time.movie_id = #{movieId} GROUP BY movie_show_time.movie_id

SELECT -- movie_show_time.movie_id, COUNT(movie_show_time.cinema_id) AS theater_count FROM movie_show_time WHERE movie_show_time.deleted = 0 AND movie_show_time.movie_id = #{movieId} GROUP BY movie_show_time.movie_id

SELECT movie.*,
COALESCE(movie.cover_url, movie.cover) AS resolved_cover, level.name AS level_name, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM re_release rr WHERE rr.deleted = 0 AND rr.movie_id = movie.id ) AS has_re_release FROM movie LEFT JOIN level ON movie.level_id = level.id
movie.deleted = 0

SELECT staff.id AS staff_id, staff.name AS staff_name, staff.cover AS staff_avatar, position.id AS positon_id, position.name AS position_name FROM movie_staff LEFT JOIN staff ON movie_staff.staff_id = staff."id" LEFT JOIN "position" ON movie_staff.position_id = "position"."id" WHERE movie_staff.deleted = 0 AND movie_staff.movie_id = #{movieId}

SELECT movie.id, movie.name,
COALESCE(movie.cover_url, movie.cover) AS cover, movie.start_date, level.name AS level_name, presale.id AS presale_id, (presale.id IS NOT NULL) AS has_presale_ticket, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM presale_specification ps WHERE ps.presale_id = presale.id AND (COALESCE(ps.bonus_title, '') != '' OR ps.bonus_included = true) )) AS has_bonus, COUNT(DISTINCT movie_show_time.id) AS show_time_count, MIN(movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp) AS show_time FROM movie_show_time LEFT JOIN movie ON movie_show_time.movie_id = movie.id LEFT JOIN level ON movie.level_id = level.id LEFT JOIN presale ON presale.movie_id = movie.id AND presale.deleted = 0 WHERE movie_show_time.deleted = 0 AND movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND movie_show_time.open = TRUE AND movie.kind = 'movie' GROUP BY movie.id, movie.name, movie.cover, movie.start_date, level.name, presale.id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT movie_show_time.id) DESC, MIN(movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp) ASC

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT movie.id, movie.name, movie.original_name, movie.description, COALESCE(movie.cover_url, movie.cover) AS cover, movie.level_id, movie.status, movie.start_date, movie.end_date, movie.time, movie.watched_count, movie.want_to_see_count, level.name AS levelName, COUNT(DISTINCT movie_show_time.id) AS presaleShowTimeCount, MIN(movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp) AS earliestShowTime, presale.id AS presaleId, (presale.id IS NOT NULL) AS hasPresaleTicket, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM presale_specification ps WHERE ps.presale_id = presale.id AND (COALESCE(ps.bonus_title, '') != '' OR ps.bonus_included = true) )) AS hasBonus, CASE WHEN movie.start_date IS NULL OR movie.start_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS start_date_empty_order, COALESCE(crawl.loose_release_to_date(movie.start_date), DATE '9999-12-31') AS start_date_order,
regexp_replace( regexp_replace( regexp_replace(lower(movie.name), '(?:通常上映?|\\s通常)\\s*$', '', 'g'), '(?:\\.\\.\\.|…).*$', '', 'g' ), '[\\s ・·!！?？.,．、，;:：。''"()（）\\[\\]［］{}「」『』〈〉【】_／/\\\\—–<>＜＞&＆-]+', '', 'g' ) AS dedupe_key FROM "movie" LEFT JOIN level ON movie.level_id = level.id LEFT JOIN movie_show_time ON movie.id = movie_show_time.movie_id AND movie_show_time.deleted = 0 AND movie_show_time.open = TRUE AND movie_show_time.start_time::timestamp > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LEFT JOIN presale ON presale.movie_id = movie.id AND presale.deleted = 0 WHERE movie.deleted = 0 AND movie.kind = 'movie' AND (
movie.start_date IS NULL OR movie.start_date = '' OR COALESCE(crawl.loose_release_to_date(movie.start_date), DATE '9999-12-31') > CURRENT_DATE ) GROUP BY movie.id, movie.name, movie.cover, movie.cover_url, movie.start_date, movie.time, movie.original_name, movie.description, movie.level_id, movie.status, movie.deleted, movie.create_time, movie.update_time, level.name, presale.id ), ranked AS ( SELECT candidate.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY candidate.start_date_order, candidate.dedupe_key ORDER BY CASE WHEN candidate.cover IS NULL OR candidate.cover = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN candidate.name ~ '(\\.\\.\\.|…)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN candidate.name ~ '\\s通常(?:上映)?\\s*$' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, char_length(candidate.name) DESC, candidate.id ASC ) AS rn FROM candidate ) SELECT id, name, original_name, description, cover, level_id, status, start_date, end_date, time, watched_count, want_to_see_count, levelName, presaleShowTimeCount, earliestShowTime, presaleId, hasPresaleTicket, hasBonus FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY start_date_empty_order ASC, start_date_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT movie.*,
COALESCE(movie.cover_url, movie.cover) AS resolved_cover, level.name AS level_name, level.description AS level_description FROM movie LEFT JOIN level ON movie.level_id = level.id WHERE movie.id = #{id}
SELECT movie_rate.movie_id, round(AVG(rate), 1) AS rate, COUNT(rate) AS total_ratings FROM movie_rate WHERE movie_rate.movie_id = #{id} GROUP BY movie_id

SELECT position.id as position_id, position.name as position_name, staff.id as staff_id, staff.name as staff_name, staff.cover as staff_cover FROM movie_staff LEFT JOIN position ON movie_staff.position_id = position.id LEFT JOIN staff ON movie_staff.staff_id = staff.id WHERE movie_staff.deleted = 0 AND movie_staff.movie_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT character.id as character_id, character.name as character_name, character.cover as character_cover, staff.id as staff_id, staff.name as staff_name FROM movie_version LEFT JOIN movie_version_character mvc ON movie_version.id = mvc.movie_version_id AND mvc.deleted::integer = 0 LEFT JOIN character ON mvc.character_id = character.id LEFT JOIN movie_version_character_staff mvcs ON mvc.movie_version_id = mvcs.movie_version_id AND mvc.character_id = mvcs.character_id AND (mvcs.deleted::integer = 0 OR mvcs.deleted IS NULL) LEFT JOIN staff ON mvcs.staff_id = staff.id WHERE movie_version.movie_id = #{id} AND movie_version.deleted::integer = 0 AND character.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY character.id, staff.id
